reason: windows-hook-gates round 4 (PR #100): delegation now executes on native Windows and fails in factory_lib's symlink-safe writers — the fd-based walk (os.open on a directory, dir_fd=, O_NOFOLLOW) is POSIX-only: Windows cannot os.open a directory (no FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS) and does not support dir_fd, so safe_factory_write_bytes/_safe_factory_fd always return False/None and forge delegate refuses at the brief write ('cannot safely write .factory/briefs/T1.md'). Fix: an nt branch that approximates the no-symlink guarantee via per-component lstat reparse-point refusal plus the same fstat regular+nlink==1 leaf check; POSIX path byte-identical.
